statements: INV-009: at most one active grant per (viewer_id, project_id) and per (service_principal_id, project_id)

INV-021: re-publication with identical (project, estimate_id, estimate_version) and identical fingerprint is an idempotent replay; a different fingerprint for the same identity is an integrity conflict storing nothing

INV-030: one recognized_document_id creates at most one Expense and one ExpenseDocument; equal intake_fingerprint replay returns the existing records, while a different fingerprint is an integrity conflict changing nothing
INV-042: a WorkPayment is idempotent by payment_id and is never a factura or accounting posting; payments total is derived
INV-043: a ProgressPhoto is idempotent by intake_id; the gallery is chronological; visibility changes never alter financial or progress data

items.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-037 [witness: verification:project_tracking_audit_writer_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-037 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal]; INV-041 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-037: all monetary values are EUR with decimal 2-digit semantics and ROUND_HALF_UP; foreign currency input is rejected explicitly, never converted
INV-041: completed work value and overall progress follow the R9 formulas; overall progress is unavailable, never guessed, when no planned work cost exists

verdicts.why: The check asserts WorkPayment replay and conflict behavior for a reused payment_id without additional persisted payment/audit records. It does not assert that payments are excluded from factura/accounting postings, that payment totals are derived, or any part of INV-009, INV-021, INV-030, or INV-043.
